title: 第17章 五行化焰诀第18章 实战课程
slug: 精灵族的修仙者第342章巢穴
content_zh:
十四年一晃而过。
晨曦历9281年。
在日夜不辍的修炼下，加上聚灵符和归墟吞海功的辅助，安东终于赶在60岁生日之前，成功突破至练气中期。
感受着丹田内徐徐涌动的十八口太初灵气，安东胸中一阵激荡，差点忍不住想要大叫一声，发泄心里的兴奋。
那感觉就像是前世游戏里终于攒够经验条，看着角色等级数字跳动的瞬间，有种沉甸甸的满足感。
现在他算是理解，为什么修仙者突破境界后都喜欢长啸一声了。
突破到炼气中期，意味着安东终于可以开始修习术法了。
首要目标自然是掌握灵火，之后才可以开始学习炼丹。
安东心心念念的，自然是被称为炼气期修士至宝的培元丹。
别看他现在只炼化出十八口灵气，距离筑基要求的一百零八口灵气还差了很大一截。
可只要有充足的培元丹，接下来炼化灵气的速度将远超从前，说不定一年都不用就能炼化出一口灵气。
这就是资源的重要性。
“修仙四要素，财侣法地，财排在了第一位。”
“这要是在修仙世界，背靠宗门，炼出第一口灵气后就有培元丹辅助修炼，最多十来年就能突破到炼气中期，哪用得着像我这样一点一点磨。”
感叹了几句，安东收敛思绪，定位灵魂深处的大道玉简。
炼气期修士受限于灵气浅薄，能选择的灵火范围十分有限。
最常见的几类，分别是兽魂火、石中火和丹煞火。
兽魂火以妖兽精魂为引炼成，威力尚可，但受限于妖兽生前属性，难以灵活变化。
石中火从地脉浅层引出，威力平平，多为辅助炼丹或提纯矿石时使用。
丹煞火则是炼丹师以自身丹毒、药渣反炼而成的剧毒灵火，只能用来炼制毒丹、蛊丹，用途很受限制。

这些灵火要么威力不足，要么用途受限，都不是好的选择。
而那些顶尖的灵火，比如三昧真火、南明离火、青莲地火、太阴真火等等，已经属于神通层级，根本不是区区炼气期能修炼得了的。
有鉴于此，一些修仙大能便投入大量心血精力，创造和完善出了一种‘不借外物、以自身之力化虚为实’的自修凝聚高阶火种的法门。
简单来讲，就是不借助外火、灵兽、灵石，完全以自身为炉，从无到有炼出一缕灵火。
事实上，这种法门并非凭空造出来的，而是参考了三昧真火的修炼理念。
三昧真火便是以自身精、气、神为燃料，三者合一而生火。
参照这个理念，再降低对精气神三者强度的要求，就能炼化出弱化版的三昧真火。
而大道玉简里，像自修凝聚火种的功法，足足有上万种。
有的侧重以精血为引，有的侧重以神识为炉，五花八门，各有所长。
安东从中挑选出了一门最顶尖，同时也最适合自身的功法——五行化焰诀。
这门功法所凝聚出的灵火名为五行真火，又称为五行轮转灵火。
顾名思义，就是能在五行之力之间交替轮转。
除了可以炼制任何属性的丹药外，对敌时还能瞬间切换火焰属性，专克敌人弱点。
哪怕是到了筑基期，五行真火依旧算得上顶尖杀伐手段。
content_en:
Fourteen years flew by.
Dawn calendar year 9281.
After practicing day and night, and with the help of the Soul Gathering Talisman and the Gui Xu Swallowing Sea Kung Fu, Anton finally succeeded in breaking through to the middle stage of Qi training before his 60th birthday.
Feeling the eighteen mouthfuls of Taichu spiritual energy slowly surging in his Dantian, Anton felt a surge of excitement in his chest, and he almost couldn't help but want to scream to vent his excitement.
It felt like I had finally accumulated enough experience bars in a previous game, and the moment I watched the character level numbers jump, I felt a heavy sense of satisfaction.
Now he finally understands why cultivators like to roar after breaking through the realm.
Breaking through to the middle stage of Qi refining means that Anton can finally start practicing magic.
The first goal is naturally to master the spiritual fire, and then you can start learning alchemy.
What Anton is thinking about is naturally the Peiyuan Pill, which is known as the most precious treasure for monks in the Qi Refining Stage.
Don't look at it. He has only refined eighteen puffs of spiritual energy now, which is still a long way from the one hundred and eight puffs of spiritual energy required for foundation building.
But as long as there are enough Peiyuan Pills, the speed of refining spiritual energy will be much faster than before. Maybe you can refine a breath of spiritual energy without even using it for a year.
This is the importance of resources.
"The four elements of cultivating immortality are the law of wealth, and wealth ranks first."
"If you were in the world of cultivating immortals, relying on the sect, and having the Peiyuan Pill to assist you in your cultivation after you refine the first breath of spiritual energy, you would be able to break through to the middle stage of Qi refining in at most ten years. There would be no need to grind bit by bit like me."
After sighing a few words, Anton gathered his thoughts and located the jade slip deep in his soul.
The monks in the Qi refining stage are limited by their shallow spiritual energy, and the range of spiritual fire they can choose is very limited.
The most common types are beast soul fire, stone fire and elixir fire.
The beast soul fire is made from the spirit of the demon beast. It is quite powerful, but it is limited by the attributes of the demon beast during its lifetime and is difficult to change flexibly.
The fire in the stone is drawn from the shallow layers of the earth's veins, and its power is mediocre. It is mostly used to assist in elixir refining or purification of ores.
Dansha Fire is a highly poisonous spiritual fire made by an alchemist using his own erysipelas and medicine residues to refine. It can only be used to refine poison pills and poison pills, and its uses are very limited.
These spiritual fires are either not powerful enough or have limited uses, so they are not good choices.
And those top spiritual fires, such as Samadhi True Fire, Nanming Li Fire, Qinglian Earth Fire, Taiyin True Fire, etc., are already at the level of supernatural powers and cannot be cultivated in the Qi Refining Period.
In view of this, some great immortal cultivators put a lot of effort and energy into creating and perfecting a method of self-study to condense high-level fire without borrowing external objects and using their own power to turn the void into reality.
To put it simply, it is to use oneself as the furnace completely to refine a ray of spiritual fire from scratch without the help of external fire, spiritual beasts or spiritual stones.
In fact, this method is not created out of thin air, but refers to the practice concept of Samadhi True Fire.
The true fire of samadhi uses one's own essence, energy, and spirit as fuel, and the three are combined into one to create fire.
By referring to this concept and lowering the requirements for the strength of the three elements of essence, energy and spirit, we can refine a weakened version of Samadhi True Fire.
And in the Dao Jade Slips, there are tens of thousands of self-cultivation techniques to condense fire.
Some focus on using essence and blood as the guide, and some focus on using spiritual consciousness as the furnace. There are many kinds of methods, each with its own strengths.
Anton selected one of the top techniques that was also the most suitable for him - the Five Elements Flame Transformation Technique.
The spiritual fire condensed by this technique is called the Five Elements True Fire, also known as the Five Elements Revolving Spiritual Fire.
As the name suggests, it can alternate between the powers of the five elements.
In addition to being able to refine elixirs of any attribute, it can also instantly switch to fire attributes when fighting enemies, specifically targeting the enemy's weaknesses.
Even in the foundation building stage, Five Elements True Fire is still considered a top killing method.
